mapper.select: SELECT name FROM certifications WHERE cert_id = #{certId};
SELECT cert_id, name FROM certifications ORDER BY name ASC;
SELECT c.cert_id, c.name, COUNT(p.problem_id) AS `problemCount` FROM certifications c LEFT JOIN problems p ON c.cert_id = p.cert_id GROUP BY c.cert_id, c.name ORDER BY c.name ASC;
